observation.visible_scene: A close, slightly high-angle static shot of a yellow electric wax/sugar warmer resting on a glossy white tabletop. The pot has a silver-rimmed opening filled with melted yellow wax and a paler, partly solid chunk floating in the center; a yellow handle projects to the right, a dark round dial sits on the front, and a small red indicator light glows at the lower front edge. A translucent bowl rim is cut off at the bottom-left corner, and a bright rectangular reflection appears on the table at the upper-right.
visible_changes: No object displacement or camera movement is detectable across the excerpt: the pot, handle, dial, bowl edge, and table reflection occupy the same positions in the first and last frames.
The red indicator light at the front base remains continuously lit throughout.
The partially solid wax chunk inside the pot keeps the same shape and position, with no visible melting progress within this short window.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the device was switched on before this segment, and whether the wax eventually melts fully afterward, are not shown.
Any contact with the handle, dial, or contents is not captured.
uncertain_details: Very subtle sub-frame motion or flicker of the indicator light cannot be confirmed from the sampled frames.
The exact material of the pot contents (wax vs. sugar paste) is inferred from appearance only.
